title: Raku Party 2026
source_quote: Raku Party 2026 Date: Saturday, October 10, starting at 10:00 am - 6:00 pm.
evidence_sentence: The Raku Party workshop page states participants choose and glaze pots to be fired in the Raku Kiln.
evidence_quote: Once we've loaded all of your section's pots into the Raku Kiln, it will fire for about 45 minutes, then it will be pulled from the hot kiln and sent through the Western Raku process
summary: Raku Party is sold out. On October 10, 2026, participants choose a pre-made vessel, glaze it with instruction, and watch it fire in a raku kiln and go through the Western Raku reduction process ($90 per person, seven time slots).
how_to_join: Pre-registration through website (all sections sold out)
